lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in at least four primary longitudinal rows, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a coordinate-like arrangement of light nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges run parallel across the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with light-colored upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple Echeneidae (remoras) are visible, with several attached to the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral body wall.
